name: Research spikes and prototypes
description: Answers a question, or settles a set of unknowns, without changing your code: you say what you need to know and why, the AI reads the docs and code (RESEARCH.md), then rounds of research spikes and throwaway prototypes (which you approve, and accept or reject) loop back to research until nothing is left to find out. It ends with ANSWER.md: the answer, how sure it is, the evidence and what to do next. Nothing is merged; prototypes stay on their own branches.

steps.name: Ask the question
steps.instructions: Say what you want to find out. Your answers become INTENT.md in the scratch directory ({{scratch.dir}}), which every later step reads.

inputs.label: What we need to know
inputs.help: The question, or the unknowns, one per line.

inputs.label: Why it matters
inputs.help: The decision or work the answer feeds, and what changes depending on it.

inputs.label: What we already know
inputs.help: What you've read, tried or ruled out.

inputs.label: Constraints
inputs.help: Anything an answer must respect: platforms, licences, budget, dependencies, deadlines.

inputs.label: How to find out
inputs.help: Spikes answer by reading (docs, code, the web); prototypes are throwaway code on their own branch.

inputs.label: Done when
inputs.help: What a good enough answer looks like.

inputs.label: Brain dump
inputs.help: Any other thoughts, links, hunches or worries.

with.extra: This is research, not a change: under What likely has to change, say instead what each possible answer would change. Give the answer as far as the docs and code settle it, and put every part they don't under Open questions.
The user wants this settled with: {{steps.question.inputs.approach}}. Don't list the other kind unless the question can't be settled without it, and say why under ## Why.

steps.name: Write the answer
steps.prompt:
Answer the question for {{ticket.title}}.

Read, in {{scratch.path}}: INTENT.md (the question and why it matters), RESEARCH.md, FINDINGS.md if there is one, and every spike-*.md and prototype-*.md ticket with its _REPORT.md. Do not change any files. Build only on prototypes a person accepted; a rejected prototype's approach is not an answer.

{{feedback}}

Reply with ANSWER.md, in markdown, and nothing else:

# Answer: {{ticket.title}}
## The question
## The answer
(short and direct, for each thing we needed to know; say how sure you are and why)
## Evidence
(each source, spike and prototype, with what it showed)
## Prototypes
(each one's branch, whether a person accepted it, and whether it is worth keeping)
## What it means
(for the decision or work in Why it matters)
## Still unknown
(and how to find out, or none)
## Next steps
